'''A Hunt Through Night''' is a [[Character Event Warp]] in [[Version 4.1]].

==Event Details==
During the event, the drop rate of the limited 5{{star}} character {{Character Intro|Ashveil}} will be boosted.

===Drop Rate Boost: 5{{star}} Character===
* {{Character Intro|Ashveil}}

===Drop Rate Boost: 4{{star}} Characters===
* {{Character Intro|Asta}}
* {{Character Intro|Moze}}
* {{Character Intro|Misha}}

==Notes==
* This Warp runs for the entire duration of Version 4.1 instead of the standard half-patch duration.
* Among the above characters, the limited character will not be available in the [[Stellar Warp]] event.
* This Warp is counted as a Character Event Warp. The Warp count for the guarantee with any Character Event Warp will always be carried over to other Character Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
{{For|additional information|Warp}}
